Reference sprites produced by libdragon's own `mksprite -f RGBA16 -c 0`, from
images generated by the deterministic formula in `tests/test_make_sprite.py`.

They exist so the test suite can prove `tools/make_sprite.py` still writes
libdragon's container correctly without requiring the libdragon toolchain to be
installed. Regenerate them only when deliberately following an upstream format
change, and say so in the commit.
